verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only kitty's startup sessions, which let you pre-define working environments (tabs and layouts) at launch. Community comments mention default startup tabs and that kitty 'reopens fullscreen like last time', but nothing shows kitty capturing and restoring live windows, tabs and working directories after a restart or crash. A hand-written startup spec is a related but different feature, and `kitten @ ls` state output is only a building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can restore my windows, tabs, and working directories after a restart or crash
